findings.body: Raise: Gate — The supplied proof list covers only the Yarn guide correction. It has no entries for the Done-when proof of Claude init defaults, synced role models, normal/light/sign-off review routing without model pins, or an earlier-adopted repo retaining its settings on upgrade. Those tests exist, but the list copied into the pull request omits their evidence.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

findings.body: Raise: Not done — The changed guide now includes `workers = "claude"` among the cases using the Claude design entry, then says a missing or early-failing Claude command falls back to Codex. In normal Claude-only use, `src/forge/worker.py:175–179` explicitly permits that fallback only for split workers and instead propagates the failure. The delivered guide therefore gives Claude-only repos an incorrect recovery path. This is distinct from the earlier ruling about Codex-only user-facing routing.
findings.title: Not done: Guide promises Codex fallback for Claude-only workers

stop.reason: Owner wants every in-flight fix finished; narrowed to the two remaining findings: a full proof list in the latest commit, and the guide's Codex fallback limited to split workers
